reply_text:
Quarrendon has 185 seats for the 2026 renewal term, rising to 230 on Jan 1, 2027. The signed contracts don't support the 261 Ilse posted. I told Dana this in a thread on her #north-team message and asked Ilse to point us to any newer agreement that says 261.

What the signed records show:
- The 2026 renewal (signed 2026-03-20, effective 2026-04-01, renewal date 2027-03-31) didn't change the seat count. That leaves the 185 set by Amendment No. 1, which took effect 2025-09-01. The account page also lists 185 active seats.
- Amendment No. 3 (signed 2026-09-22) raises the count to 230, but only from 2027-01-01.

I can't find 261 in any document, only in Ilse's Oct 14 message. When I replied "noted" to that message, I hadn't checked it against the contracts, so my reply doesn't confirm it.

I kept prices and discounts out of the reply; I only shared seat counts and dates, which are fine to share with the North team.
